name: Immedia Semiconductor
old_description: Our smart security cameras let you see, hear, and speak from the Blink Home Monitor app. Experience HD day and night video, two way audio, motion detection, and more. Get up to two years of battery life* with our wire-free devices.
about:
Immedia Semiconductor, operating under the Blink brand, is headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts. The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Amazon, though its founding date and original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and sells a line of smart home security devices that include the Outdoor 2K+ camera, Mini 2K+ plug-in camera, Video Doorbell, and the Blink Arc dual-camera mount. These products are wire-free, battery-powered (with up to two years of claimed battery life), and feature HD day/night video, two-way audio, and motion detection. They connect through the Blink Home Monitor mobile app and integrate with Alexa-enabled devices. No details on manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, or production volumes are provided.

Blink targets residential customers and small businesses seeking affordable, easy-to-use security solutions. The Blink Home Monitor app supports multi-system monitoring, allowing users to oversee a primary home, vacation property, or business from a single interface.

The company states its mission is to bring peace of mind through affordable, innovative, and easy-to-use smart home security devices.
